lessons: The premise holds. tests/integration/test_rework.py:452-453 renders clutch/specs/rework.md and checks the result's SHA-256 against a fixed digest (29fedebf...). Any Role sentence added to rework.md changes that digest, and the scope fence does not let the attempt edit test_rework.py.

Fix the ticket: add tests/integration/test_rework.py to the scope fence. Add a criterion to update only the hash at line 453 to the new render's digest, and add test_rework.py to the Verification command. No other test pins a rendered stage-spec hash; a grep of tests/ found only test_rework.py.

On the next attempt, keep the rest as the ticket says. Spell the delimiter in words in each ## Role section, bump no version, and put the new test in tests/integration/test_specs_delimiter_note.py. Fix the ruff import-order finding in that new file before committing.
